Clinic introduction

Appearance

We are located on the 4th floor of the Kamirokutoki Building. Please use the elevator.

reception

We ask that you keep your medical card and fill out the medical questionnaire.

waiting room

A USB port is available at each seat. You can wait comfortably while protecting your privacy with the partition.

counseling room

hair removal room

peeling room

operating room

In-hospital video

Equipment introduction

derma pen

Light Sheer Duet (hair removal)

Ultracell Q+ (HIFU)

PicoWay (Pico Laser)

Re-Beau2 (skin diagnosis)

Regarding infectious disease countermeasures

At our hospital, we are taking measures to prevent coronavirus infections.

Avoiding close contact between patients
  • Ensuring distance between patients in the waiting room
  • Adjustment of reservation time
disinfection
  • Hand disinfection by staff after each patient treatment
  • Disinfection of beds, treatment machines, and equipment after each patient treatment
  • Regular disinfection of areas that may be touched by patients and staff, such as doorknobs, handrails, and tables.
Droplet infection countermeasures/ventilation
  • Installation of reception partition
  • Staff wearing masks, goggles, and face shields
  • Constant operation of commercial air purifiers
  • regular ventilation
Staff health management
  • Check body temperature and physical condition when coming to work
  • Thorough hand disinfection

We would like patients to cooperate with us.

  • If you have any symptoms that suggest you may be infected with the new coronavirus, such as fever, cough, or sore throat, please call our clinic by phone before coming to our clinic, even if it is just before your appointment time.
  • Please wear a mask when visiting the hospital. Also, be sure to cover your nose and wear your mask correctly.
  • After your visit, please help us disinfect your hands. We have disinfectant available.
  • Please cooperate with cough etiquette.
